description:
Yun Jin ( Chinese : 云堇 Yún Jǐn ) is a playable Geo character in Genshin Impact .

A famous figure in Liyue Harbor 's opera scene, Yun Jin is the director of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe, and performs at Heyu Tea House from time to time. She is also a playwright, having written all the plays the Yun-Han Opera Troupe has performed in recent years, including a new ending for "The Divine Damsel of Devastation."
role_summary: Yun Jin ( Chinese : 云堇 Yún Jǐn ) is a playable Geo character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Cloud-Grazing Strike
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Opening Flourish
talents.description: Ms. Yun may just be acting out fights on stage, but her skills with the spear are real enough to defend against her foes. (‍ Press Text for mouse and keyboard and controller ‍/‍ Tap Text for touch screen ‍) Flourishes her polearm in a cloud-grasping stance, dealing Geo DMG . Hold Takes up the Opening Flourish stance and charges up, forming a shield. DMG Absorption is based on Yun Jin's Max HP and has 150% effectiveness against all Elemental DMG and Physical DMG . The shield lasts until she finishes unleashing her Elemental Skill. When the skill is released, when its duration ends, or when the shield breaks, Yun Jin will unleash the charged energy as an attack, dealing Geo DMG . Based on the time spent charging, it will either unleash an attack at Charge

talents.name: Cliffbreaker's Banner
talents.description: Deals AoE Geo DMG and grants all nearby party members a Flying Cloud Flag Formation. Flying Cloud Flag Formation When Normal Attack DMG is dealt to opponents, Bonus DMG will be dealt based on Yun Jin's current DEF. The effects of this skill will be cleared after a set duration or after being triggered a specific number of times. When one Normal Attack hits multiple opponents, the effect is triggered multiple times according to the number of opponents hit. The number of times that the effect is triggered is counted independently for each member of the party with Flying Cloud Flag Formation.

talents.name: Breaking Conventions
talents.description: The Normal Attack DMG Bonus granted by Flying Cloud Flag Formation is further increased by 2.5%/5%/7.5%/11.5% of Yun Jin's DEF when the party contains characters of 1/2/3/4 Elemental Types, respectively.

talents.name: Light Nourishment
talents.description: When Perfect Cooking is achieved on Food with Adventure-related effects , there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

c1.name: Thespian Gallop
c1.effect: Opening Flourish 's CD is decreased by 18%.

c2.name: Myriad Mise-En-Scène
c2.effect: After Cliffbreaker's Banner is unleashed, all nearby party members' Normal Attack DMG is increased by 15% for 12s.

c3.name: Seafaring General
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Cliffbreaker's Banner by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Flower and a Fighter
c4.effect: When Yun Jin triggers Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize reactions, her DEF is increased by 20% for 12s.

c5.name: Famed Throughout the Land
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Opening Flourish by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Decorous Harmony
c6.effect: Characters under the effects of the Flying Cloud Flag Formation have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 12%.
